name: netcatty
description: Netcatty is a modern SSH manager and terminal app with host grouping, SFTP, keychain, port forwarding, and a rich UI.
author: binaricat <support@netcatty.com>

scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/wails-prepare-frontend.mjs && go run ./cmd/netcatty
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean:vite && npm run dev
scripts.build:plugin-runtime-deps: npm run build --workspace @netcatty/plugin-contract && npm run build --workspace @netcatty/plugin-sdk && npm run build --workspace @netcatty/plugin-cli
scripts.build:plugin-packages: npm run generate:plugin-contract && npm run build:plugin-runtime-deps && npm run build --workspace @netcatty/example-hello-plugin
scripts.check:profile-store: go test -count=1 ./internal/profile/... && go test -race -count=1 ./internal/profile/... && go vet ./internal/profile/...
scripts.check:credentials: go test -count=1 ./internal/platform/credentials/... && go test -race -count=1 ./internal/platform/credentials/... && go vet ./internal/platform/credentials/...
scripts.check:terminal-dataplane-core: go test -count=1 ./internal/terminal/dataplane/... && go test -race -count=1 ./internal/terminal/dataplane/... && go vet ./internal/terminal/dataplane/...
scripts.wails:winres: go run github.com/wailsapp/wails/v3/cmd/wails3@v3.0.0-beta.12 generate syso -icon build/lemonssh.ico -manifest build/windows/lemonssh.manifest -arch amd64 -out cmd/netcatty/rsrc_windows_amd64.syso
scripts.wails:dev: go run github.com/wailsapp/wails/v3/cmd/wails3@v3.0.0-beta.12 generate bindings -d infrastructure/runtime/wails/bindings && go run ./cmd/netcatty
scripts.test: node --test --import tsx scripts/*.test.cjs scripts/*.test.mjs application/*.test.ts application/app/*.test.ts application/i18n/locales/*.test.ts application/state/*.test.ts application/state/*/*.test.ts components/*.test.ts components/*.test.tsx components/editor/*.test.ts components/editor/*.test.tsx components/host/*.test.ts components/host/*.test.tsx components/ui/*.test.ts components/ui/*.test.tsx components/notes/*.test.ts components/notes/*.test.tsx components/port-forwarding/*.test.ts components/scripts/*.test.tsx components/systemManager/*.test.ts components/terminalLayer/*.test.ts components/settings/*.test.tsx components/settings/tabs/*.test.ts components/settings/tabs/ai/*.test.ts components/settings/tabs/ai/*.test.tsx components/ai/*.test.ts components/ai/*.test.tsx components/ai/toolArtifacts/*.test.ts components/ai/toolArtifacts/*.test.tsx components/ai-elements/*.test.tsx components/sftp/*.test.ts components/terminal/*.test.ts components/terminal/*.test.tsx components/terminal/runtime/*.test.ts components/vault/*.test.ts components/vault/*.test.tsx components/workbench/*.test.ts components/workbench/*.test.tsx domain/*.test.ts domain/*/*.test.ts infrastructure/ai/*.test.ts infrastructure/ai/*/*.test.ts infrastructure/ai/sdk/*.test.ts infrastructure/config/*.test.ts infrastructure/monaco/*.test.ts infrastructure/persistence/*.test.ts infrastructure/runtime/*.test.ts infrastructure/runtime/*/*.test.ts infrastructure/services/*.test.ts infrastructure/services/*/*.test.ts lib/*.test.ts packages/*/src/*.test.ts
